<h1 id="revenants" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Revenants</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenants <nowiki>Revenants</nowiki>]<nowiki> are a popular type of Wilderness monster which may be found in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Forinthry_Dungeon <nowiki>Forinthry Dungeon</nowiki>]<nowiki>. They're mainly killed for the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Boss_collection_log#Chaos_Elemental <nowiki>Chaos Elemental collection log</nowiki>]<nowiki>, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Wilderness <nowiki>Wilderness collection log</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_Spirit <nowiki>Revenant Spirit</nowiki>]<nowiki> which is used to unlock the Revenant pet as well as its skins; this drop gets increasingly rarer the more skins you have.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After the Wilderness update killing revenants became substantially safer, as players can now opt-out of PvP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Forinthry_bracelet#Effects <nowiki>Forinthry bracelet</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152061350678549.png?v=1" alt="forinthrybracelet" title="forinthrybracelet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will make revenants </nowiki><strong><nowiki>NOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> be aggressive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This effect will persist for an hour and only count down while in the Forinthry Dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Even if it was used years ago, the effect may still be active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: </nowiki><em><nowiki>Varies</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~730 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Active), ~400 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Low Effort)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: </nowiki><em><nowiki>Varies</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_drop_enhancer <nowiki>Revenant drop enhancer</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1" alt="revenantdropenhancer" title="revenantdropenhancer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Salve_amulet_(e) <nowiki>Salve amulet (e)</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797899945730244648.png?v=1" alt="salveamulet" title="salveamulet" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

    • Make sure to have the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards <nowiki>Restocking Cannon</nowiki>]<nowiki> ability unlocked.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) <nowiki>Stone of Jas buff</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Revenants are located in the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Forinthry_Dungeon <nowiki>Forinthry Dungeon</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1" alt="wildernesssword" title="wildernesssword" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Forinthry Dungeon teleport.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively you may use the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552297231822878.png?v=1" alt="wildernesslode" title="wildernesslode" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and run west to the level 17 Wilderness entrance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The active Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> method consists of killing revenants using </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Legacy_Mode#Combat <nowiki>Legacy Combat Mode</nowiki>]<nowiki> one at a time following specific routes, this can be replicated using Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with an augmented </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Revenant_bane_2h_sword <nowiki>Revenant bane 2h sword</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/859483155210567741.png?v=1" alt="bane2h" title="bane2h" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The knight and dragon are the fastest spawning revenants; use routes that prioritise killing them as soon as they respawn, as they have the highest drop rates for uniques.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/hAJb1MB50g.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is positioned to kill the southern revenant goblins and imp, occasionally being able to kill the pyrefiend, and lowering the dark beast and demon such that they can be consistently one-shot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/mjtXJs8Zua.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Red</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Main routes to take when killing revenants between knight and dragon spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When going from knight to dragon, kill 3-5 revenants. When going from dragon to knight, kill 2-3 revenants.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Blue</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>yellow</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Potential detour routes for red and green routes respectively depending on revenant movement.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure Legacy Combat Mode is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535616247807868938.png?v=1" alt="bloodblitz" title="bloodblitz" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The healing from the spell alone should negate the need for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1" alt="crumbleundead" title="crumbleundead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1" alt="crumbleundead" title="crumbleundead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Crumble Undead with Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Holy Scarab </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1" alt="holyscarab" title="holyscarab" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and any overload with prayer restore to restore prayer</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=bd9925ea-3f24-4e2f-bad8-0f77ab241a65 <nowiki>Magic preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="example-kills"><nowiki>Example Kills</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/xROxupx3T6I <nowiki>Active Magic</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-low-effort-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: Low Effort Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The low effort Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> method consists of killing revenants using </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Legacy_Mode#Combat <nowiki>Legacy Combat Mode</nowiki>]<nowiki> to AFK until they are no longer aggressive. When this happens you will follow a specific route killing revenants along the way in order to reset their aggro.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/LlbDHRTBgQ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will solo kill the dragon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You AFK kill the dark beast, ork, demon, cyclops, pyrefiend, and 2 goblins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/5K8rvWazPb.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Blue</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Green</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Yellow</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Blue (back to start)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Every ~10 minutes follow the route shown above: take the outer loop to the dragon → knight → dragon → start.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Make sure to reach the marked northwesternmost tile in order to properly reset aggro.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure Legacy Combat Mode is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535616247807868938.png?v=1" alt="bloodblitz" title="bloodblitz" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The healing from the spell alone should negate the need for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1" alt="crumbleundead" title="crumbleundead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1" alt="crumbleundead" title="crumbleundead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Crumble Undead with Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Holy Scarab </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1" alt="holyscarab" title="holyscarab" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and any overload with prayer restore to restore prayer</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
